|translation='''Title:''' Sorry About The Mess.

'''Card text:'''
During your control phase, fire a weapon, using Force as usual. If Han is firing, you may add 1 to destiny. A seeker may be targeted. Treat a seeker as maneuver 4. A hit target is immediately lost.

'''Lore:'''
I've been looking forward to killing you. Yeah, I figured. Han ended the talk with Greedo roughly and tossed Wuher a cleanup fee.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is やっかいかけたな.
